hook: Want a free 10-minute written teardown of your homepage?
direction: First direct CTA. Offer a written homepage audit (delivered as a doc — AI-producible, no video) for the first several responders. Low-friction lead gen.

facebook.text:
Want a free 10-minute written teardown of your homepage?

We'll look at your headline, your call to action, and whether a first-time visitor can figure out what you do and what to do next — then write it up in a plain doc you can act on.

No video call. No sales pitch. Just honest feedback.

The first several people who comment "AUDIT" or send us a message get one. That's it.
